name: sonarqube
description: SonarQube MCP — code quality issues, security hotspots, coverage metrics, quality gate status, and source inspection

env.SONARQUBE_URL: SonarQube server URL (e.g., https://sonar.cicd.wdprapps.disney.com or https://sonar.company.com)
env.SONARQUBE_TOKEN: SonarQube user token (generated from My Account > Security)
env.SONARQUBE_ORG: Organization key (required for SonarCloud, optional for Server)
